    (hE : 0 ≤ edges) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :

      iteratedRoot (3 * (2 * r)) (primitiveBudgetCoefficient r edges * t)

    edges * p ≤ primitiveSoundnessCoefficient r edges * iteratedRoot (6 * r) t := by sorry
